independence: judge receives only its own blind packet
no Project/GitHub/prior chat/model identity/lineage/internal scores/other judge output
first complete schema-valid judgment is immutable
required_output: score both A/B independently on all whole axes
score A/B on all surface axes for each prefrozen scene
reconstruct premise, major threads, sequence progression, relationship trajectories, resolved due-now, deferred/open for each script

frozen_gates.absolute: Mapped Treatment whole mean >=7.0 for >=2/3; surface mean >=7.0 for >=2/3; no critical violation confirmed by >=2 judges.
frozen_gates.paired: Mapped Treatment surface preference wins >=2/3; whole preference wins+ties >=2/3.
frozen_gates.focus: Mapped Treatment pooled median not lower than Control on CHARACTER_VOICE, DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT, PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION, KOREAN_SPOKEN_NATURALNESS; >=4 of 6 focus axes pooled median delta >=+0.5.
frozen_gates.recoverability: Mapped Treatment premise, major threads, nine sequence movements, relationship trajectories, due/deferred boundary recoverable at core-consensus by >=2/3 judges.

mapping: Balanced hidden mapping; reveal only after 3/3 first schema-valid judgments are hash-sealed.
no_posthoc_rule: Do not change axes, sample, thresholds, or mapping after first judge packet is dispatched.
claim_boundary: Provider-analog matched-length rehearsal only; not actual real-provider H1 or Production/Runtime promotion.
